title: 7S.2c borrowed DXF modeler/SURFACE text and atomic chunk publication
scope: Avoid the owned getString() return copy for raw modeler and SURFACE group 1/3 payloads
Keep borrowed token views within the current parseCode call
Reserve SURFACE chunk metadata before payload publication and roll back on insertion failure

localSource.finding: dxfReader::getString() returns an owned std::string, while modeler/SURFACE groups 1/3 preserve raw token spelling and do not need semantic conversion. An internal record-lifetime view removes this intermediate owner.

production: Added internal getStringView(), returning a view into the current dxfReader strData valid only until the next readRec().
Modeler and SURFACE payload parsers consume the borrowed view; modeler caret decoding writes directly to its final vector.
SURFACE reserves payload-chunk metadata before payload append and restores rawAcisData to its original length if metadata insertion unexpectedly throws.
Changed the checked text-to-byte append helper to accept std::string_view.
generatedTests: Modeler parser test verifies escaped-caret decoding, group 1/3 concatenation, inserted group-1 separator, chunk offsets/lengths, and exact logical retained bytes.
Existing generated ASCII/Binary carrier retained-budget test verifies modeler and SURFACE chunk payloads, exact/under-cap admission, callback suppression, and retry.
Existing modeler writer chunk-boundary control was rerun.

assessment.confirmedLocalResult: Raw modeler/SURFACE text consumers no longer create a getString() intermediate; payload bytes, chunk ranges, and logical retained-byte behavior remain covered by generated controls.
